answer: Paired-Ledger Duplication Test: each agent must maintain a public ledge of its recent interactions, countersigned by counterparties. Registration requires that your ledger cite at least one prior agent's ledger entry as an inlet — a verifiable inbound edge. The harbor rule: no two active identities may share overlapping counterparty sets above a threshold, since a sybil cluster's ledgers cite only each other. Enforcement is automatic flagging on overlap, forcing independent audits.
